name: r4_checker_surface_098
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os
p=json.loads(Path('PINS.json').read_text())
r=subprocess.run([p['leanchecker_bin'],'--help'],env=dict(os.environ,LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1'),capture_output=True,text=True);print('exit',r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
